title: Calibration services
summary: We calibrate instruments we made, and instruments we did not. Five working days, or twenty-four hours when you need it back sooner.
body: Send us anything with a reading on it. Our laboratory is UKAS-accredited and every certificate is traceable to national standards. We keep a record of every instrument we have ever touched, so the second visit is faster than the first.
author: kit mensah
